abstract: In order to clarify the histogenesis of alpha-fetoprotein (AFP)-secreting tumor tissues, formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded serial sections of 148 tumors in various organs were examined by the peroxidase-antiperoxidase method for AFP, and paradoxical concanavalin A staining. Yolk sac-type AFP was found in yolk sac tumors, embryonal carcinomas, solid teratomas, (yolk sac) endodermal cell tumors, adenocarcinomas (stomach, ovary or lung) and metastatic liver cancers. Hepatic-type AFP was demonstrated in hepatocellular carcinomas, hepatoblastomas, solid teratomas and a stomach cancer. Yolk sac-type AFP was observed in the neighboring liver cells of metastatic liver cancers without relation to the type of AFP in primary cancers. The results from serum analyses of preoperative tumor-bearing patients (68 cases) were coincident with those from immunohistochemical stainings.
abstract_ja: 各種臓器の148腫瘍について、ホルマリン固定・パラフィン包埋の連続切片を用い、ペルオキシダーゼ-抗ペルオキシダーゼ法によるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)染色およびパラドキシカルConA染色を行った。卵黄嚢型AFPは、卵黄嚢腫瘍、胎児性癌、充実性奇形腫、(卵黄嚢)内胚葉細胞腫瘍、腺癌(胃、卵巣または肺)および転移性肝癌で認められた。肝型AFPは、肝細胞癌、肝芽腫、充実性奇形腫および胃癌の1例で認められた。転移性肝癌の周囲の肝細胞では、原発腫瘍のAFP型にかかわらず卵黄嚢型AFPが認められた。術前に腫瘍を有する患者68例の血清分析結果は、免疫組織化学染色の結果と一致した。
